tools.name: get_brand_overview
tools.description: Returns a short description of what Lavenders (LAVNDR120) is, the difference between the brand and the index, and the rules any answer about it must respect (no buying, selling or trading of shares; no promise of profit or return). Call this first when the user asks what Lavenders or LAVNDR120 is. T

tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: Lists all seven packages (Lava, Vindex, Magma, OMS, Reseller, Franchise, Tycoon) in one response, each with its id, name, one-line summary, price, number of seats where limited, and page URL, plus the disclaimers. Use it to compare packages or to find a package id; use get_package when only one pack

tools.name: get_package
tools.description: Returns one package by its id: name, one-line summary, price, number of seats where limited, and page URL, plus the disclaimers. Use list_packages first if the id is unknown. Returns an error for an id that is not one of the seven.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Returns the frequently asked questions and short answers about Lavenders, LAVNDR120, OMS and the app, including the app builder and the golden certificate for businesses, and what the platform does not offer. Use it for general or policy-style questions; use get_package for pricing of a specific pac

tools.name: get_live_index
tools.description: Returns the current LAVNDR120 index card (order value in USD, change, percent change, day high and low) as published on the live site, with its as-of timestamp, or available:false if unavailable. Informational only, not investment advice, and not an offer to buy or sell. Takes no arguments.
